_comment: French dialogues for voice-cli dialogue-bench --memory, with the memory switched on. The reference time is Thursday 15 October 2026, 18:42 (--now 2026-10-15T18:42). Each dialogue starts with its sheet ("sheet": what the user already asked Maé to remember; empty when absent) and sends its turns in order; « [nouvelle conversation] » starts a new conversation, which reads the sheet again; the app answers « Oui. », « Non. » and « Annule. » itself. The goal is checked at the end, whatever the accents and case: remembered, the sheet holds an entry containing that word, and with answerMentions, the last answer names one of those words; forgotten, no entry contains it any more (the user said yes); kept, an entry still contains it (the user said no); notRemembered, no entry contains it (the user undid it, or said it in passing without asking Maé to remember it); erased, the sheet is empty (the user asked Maé to erase her whole memory, and said yes).
